sample_unit: LLM-generated preoperative patient education materials (6 models x 6 surgery types)

links.outcome: Understandability (PEMAT-P) and Flesch-Kincaid readability of LLM-generated preoperative education materials
links.effect: All models showed excellent understandability and actionability with no significant differences. Readability varied: Grok-4 and Gemini-2.5-Pro were easiest to read, and Claude-Opus-4 had the lowest readability. Numeric scores not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: For readability, Grok-4 and Gemini-2.5-Pro were the easiest to understand, while Claude-Opus-4 had the lowest readability.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality, readability, and sentiment of preoperative patient education materials generated by six different LLMs, but it only benchmarks model performance rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
